```yaml
name: DB Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  db-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: testdb
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U test"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      pgbouncer:
        image: edoburu/pgbouncer:latest
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://test:test@postgres:5432/testdb
        ports:
          - 6432:6432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U test -p 6432"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      mysql:
        image: mysql:8
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
          MYSQL_DATABASE: testdb
          MYSQL_USER: test
          MYSQL_PASSWORD: test
        ports:
          - 3306:3306
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "mysqladmin ping -h localhost -u root -proot"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/go-build
            ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run DB integration tests
        env:
          POSTGRES_HOST: localhost
          POSTGRES_PORT: 5432
          POSTGRES_USER: test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: testdb
          PGBOUNCER_HOST: localhost
          PGBOUNCER_PORT: 6432
          PGBOUNCER_URL: postgres://test:test@pgbouncer:6432/testdb
          MYSQL_HOST: localhost
          MYSQL_PORT: 3306
          MYSQL_USER: test
          MYSQL_PASSWORD: test
          MYSQL_DATABASE: testdb
          MYSQL_URL: mysql://test:test@localhost:3306/testdb
        run: go test -tags=integration ./...
```
